description.text: CourseRequired CoursesOral Chinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese Conversation, Chinese Translation, Chinese Writing (specific courses can be arranged upon request)Optional CoursesChinese Martial Arts (Taichi), Chinese Calligraphy, Traditional Chinese Music Instruments, How to Make Chinese Knots, Chinese Paper-cutting, Selected Excellent Chinese Movies, How to Make Traditional Chinese FoodsLecturesEducation in China, Chinese Festivals, Chinese Names, Chinese Painting, Beijing Opera, Chinese History, Traditional Chinese Music and DancesDuration of Study2-6 weeksTuitionWithin four Weeks, CNY 1,000/week;over four weeks, CNY 600/week from the fifth week on

duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Language and Culture at Binzhou University is a 6 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 138 USD/per week ￥ 1000 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Be in good health 2.Aged of16 to 65 3.Be interested in studying in Binzhou University.
